title: Finite Contact Theory v0.11: The Clean Mixed-State Exclusion
description: A finite reconstruction program for admissible reality. Chapters 1-9 recovered known structure from a finite-contact floor. Chapter 10, the program's first extension chapter, predicts a possible violation of Hilbert-space positivity and recovers nothing; Chapter 11 (this v0.11 release) proves the clean mixed-state exclusion that closes its clean core. Two things are published and held rigidly apart. (A) THE THEOREM, unconditional: a three-contact class function with a negative sign-sector eigenvalue (1 - 3r^2 - 2r^3 < 0 for r > 1/2) nonetheless keeps every physically accessible passive-linear-optical probability nonnegative. The accessible amplitudes are the monomials z_sigma = prod_i A[i][sigma(i)] of one complex 3x3 interferometer matrix; they obey the toric identity prod_even z = prod_odd z; and at the registered point r = 3/5 the exact inequality 152||z||^2 + 9|per A|^2 - 36|det A|^2 >= 0 holds for every complex 3x3 A (per A = sum z, det A = sum sgn(sigma) z), proven using only the toric relation and with equality only at A = 0. Because the form is degree-6 homogeneous, positivity holds for every passive-linear-optical transfer matrix, lossless or lossy; on the lossless unitary core U(3) the sharper strict (7/2)||z||^2 margin holds (the Fourier tritter saturating), while the (7/2) margin for arbitrary matrices is FALSE (an explicit -495 witness) and stays killed. So the sector is a lawful probabilistic model on the complete admitted grammar that lies OUTSIDE the positive-semidefinite Hilbert Gram cone: global Hilbert PSD fails while operational block positivity survives. (B) THE PREDICTION, conditional and experiment-open: on a received apparatus anchor r = 3/5 and the odd Z_2 identity-holonomy sector (Phi = pi), the three-state Gram discriminant is Delta_3 = 1 - 3r^2 - 2r^3 = (1-2r)(1+r)^2 = -64/125 < 0, where ordinary complex-Hilbert quantum mechanics forces Delta_3 = det G >= 0 (at r = 3/5 the PSD cone caps the cyclic phase at Phi <= arccos(5/27) ~ 79.3 deg while the extension reaches Phi = pi). The registered joint count vector (Delta_3, W, Q_3) = (-64/125, -128/1125, -12/125) both excludes the PSD Gram class and rejects the matched pairwise-only null (Q_3 = 0). This is a PREREGISTERED BET with a frozen protocol and kill conditions, NOT a discovery: the bridge premises (that a particle class carries Z_2 identity holonomy; that photons receive it -- the natural home is anyonic/topological matter, photons the clean-grammar long shot; that passive linear optics is the complete measurement grammar) are held open, and the decisive mixed-state / full-nuisance PSD-exclusion is an OPEN crux that has not been vetted by a quantum-optics expert. r = 3/5 is a received apparatus anchor, not a fundamental constant. This DOI is an archival / priority record of a mathematically closed conditional prediction, not an empirical discovery. One dependency-free script verifies the chapter from a clean clone in exact arithmetic: the core numbers, the foundational Fourier identity, positivity on rational toric witnesses, the unitary-core reduction and strict margin, the -495 kill of the (7/2)-universal, and separable-loss covariance, plus an independent adversarial descent over the full toric set. This v0.11 release adds Chapter 11, the clean mixed-state exclusion: the gauge-free raw-count witness W = P111 + D2 - 2/3 equals (2/9) det G for every partially-distinguishable Hilbert model at the Fourier tritter, so Gram positivity forces W >= 0 for pure and (by convexity, certified by the antisymmetrizer projector) mixed states, while the registered extension has W = -128/1125 < 0; hence no partially-distinguishable Hilbert model, pure or mixed, reproduces the registered counts, by the raw-count test P111 + D2 >= 2/3. This closes the clean mixed-state + mode-mismatch exclusion; multiphoton contamination, detector response, transfer-matrix uncertainty, and source drift remain the external experimental layer, and the bridge premises are unchanged.
